title: AIM Consulting SA
description:
[consulting] AIM Consulting SA — a Swiss managed IT-services provider (MSP) based in Ticino (Canobbio/Davesco Soragno, Strada Cantonale 11), operating domain aimconsulting.ch, serving approximately 60 client organisations across Ticino and northern Italy, including banks (Banca del Gottardo, Corner Banca, Banca dello Stato, Banca del Sempione, NBAD Private Bank Suisse), the Casinò di Campione, public and energy-sector bodies (FOFT, EnergyPowerSwiss, liquidenergy), and dozens of SMEs.
